context: Build an executable production-readiness matrix rather than a documentation-only checklist. Exercise the official MCP conformance suite plus mcp-explorer smoke coverage for modern and chosen legacy modes. Run protocol calls across two workers with a shared job/quota backend. Add SDK OpenTelemetry spans and W3C propagation with bounded, redacted attributes. Define explicit cache-control policy per endpoint/data class and prove private data cannot enter shared caches. Keep json_response disabled unless progress/notification requirements are resolved. Publish remote deployment documentation only after every required gate is automated or carries named external evidence.
description: Complete the move from localhost-capable Streamable HTTP to an operable shared service. The gate must prove MCP 2026-07-28 conformance, alternating-worker behavior, authentication and tenant isolation, workload limits, durable jobs, and safe telemetry. It must also define cacheability by data class: stable discovery metadata may use shared long-lived caching, while recent results and system-profile data remain private or short-lived. Replace reliance on the currently unused process-global metrics collector with SDK/OpenTelemetry and W3C trace propagation where appropriate.

anti_patterns.dont: publish remote endpoint instructions before the gate is satisfied
anti_patterns.instead: keep localhost docs until current acceptance evidence exists

anti_patterns.dont: share-cache recent results or system profiles
anti_patterns.instead: use private/no-store or explicitly bounded per-principal caching
anti_patterns.why: those responses can be tenant-specific or sensitive

anti_patterns.dont: treat a green unit suite as MCP conformance or production certification
anti_patterns.instead: require the executable multi-layer acceptance matrix
anti_patterns.why: protocol, proxy, worker, security, and durability failures occur above the unit boundary

anti_patterns.dont: use the process-global MCP metrics collector as cross-worker truth
anti_patterns.instead: export SDK/OpenTelemetry signals to shared observability infrastructure
anti_patterns.why: it resets on restart and fragments by worker

preserves.behavior: A pending or failed gate cannot be described as production-ready or publicly deployed
Progress notifications and future streaming remain possible unless a separate decision approves JSON-only responses
Sensitive result, system-profile, identity, and authorization data never enters a shared cache
Telemetry contains no credentials, raw database URLs, unbounded tool arguments, or result payloads
